name: sanghyun-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills by sanghyun-io: planning, RCA, API flow diagrams, multi-agent workflows, and skill authoring.

plugins.name: plan-subdivider
plugins.description: Splits a plan into ordered task files with checklists, verification steps, and prev/next links. No hooks.

plugins.name: api-flow-diagram
plugins.description: Trace every API a user journey calls (FE + BE) and render a left-to-right flow diagram HTML with branches, auth, and risk notes per screen/button.

plugins.name: multi-hypothesis
plugins.description: Root cause analysis with several competing hypotheses investigated in parallel by sub-agents, disconfirming evidence first; analysis only.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Turn the current session into a handoff prompt that a fresh session can continue from, copied to the clipboard (file or inline fallback).

plugins.name: skill-scaffolder
plugins.description: Scaffold, restructure, and package Claude Code skills: bilingual trigger descriptions, references/ layout, and plugin/marketplace publishing.

plugins.name: slack-thread-to-plan
plugins.description: Read a Slack thread from its permalink, extract requirements, and save an implementation plan file for the current project.

plugins.name: parallel-team
plugins.description: Manager pattern for running several independent coding tasks in parallel: one worktree, port, and sub-agent per task, then integration checks, ordered merges, and safe cleanup.
